title: feat(platform-objects): Add Member opened from a team binds that team
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuBKyGxNYJyVxQVGvyziBNBD)_

Fixes #25337

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

In Setup → Teams, Add Member lived only on the team-membership list's toolbar, where no team is in hand, so its dialog asked the administrator to pick the team a second time. `sys_team` now declares its own `add_team_member` action, on the team row (`list_item`) and the team record header (`record_header`):

- It calls the same `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/add-team-member` endpoint as the membership-list copy, behind the same gates (`requiresFeature: 'organization'` and `requiresMembershipReach: 'add_team_member'`).
- The team's id rides as `teamId` from the row the action is opened on (`recordIdParam: 'teamId'`), so the dialog asks only for the user (`userId`, through the membership row's `sys_user` lookup via `objectOverride: 'sys_team_member'`).
- The membership-list copy (`sys_team_member.add_team_member`) is unchanged and still asks for both.
- Translations for the new action label and success message in all four bundles; `platform-objects` patch changeset.

This is the add-member half of the card only. Under ruling C the delete half is not done: no disabled-reason key, no computed last-team fact, and `allowRemovingAllTeams` stays unset.

## Outside the claim's file surface

`packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts` gains one row, `'sys_team.actions.add_team_member'`, in `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES.organization.gatedInputs`, immediately after `'sys_team.actions.remove_team'`, with an `@objectstack/spec` patch changeset (`.changeset/25337-spec-book-team-add-member.md`). The existing `'sys_team_member.actions.add_team_member'` row (the membership-list action) is untouched.

This sits in the `domain:spec` lane and lands here under ruling `6370058183` (A + C) and its confirmation `6384716955`: `feature-gate-guard.test.ts` checks the booking in both directions, so the row can only land in the same PR as the action. A declaration is posted on spec seat post #6017. The spec face goes through the CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review before the queue.

Serial note: open PR #25626 and the second PR under #25347 each move a different row of the same file. Neither had landed when this PR opened (`origin/main` at `2c523d010`; the only commit since this branch's merge of `main` touches `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/**` and `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`). Whichever lands later merges `main` and re-runs `feature-gate-guard.test.ts`.

## Tests

All readings below are on head `67affbcd1`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/feature-gate-guard.test.ts src/identity/sys-team-add-member-action.test.ts src/platform-objects.test.ts` → 3 files, 259 tests passed (after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/platform-objects^...' build`, so the guard reads the rebuilt spec `dist/`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test` → 95 files, 1351 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/kernel/public-auth-features.test.ts src/ui/action.test.ts` → 2 files, 177 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects --filter @objectstack/spec run typecheck` → exit 0.
- ESLint (`--no-inline-config`) on the eight changed source files → exit 0.

### Ablation: the guard turns red without the row

The guard reads `@objectstack/spec/kernel` through `exports` (the built `dist/`), so each leg rebuilt spec and proved the marker's state in `dist/` before the run was read.

- Mutate: `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` deleted the row (anchor 1 → 0, blob `bc905d9641b5` → `5b8ba535bc57`); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`; `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/spec 'sys_team.actions.add_team_member' --absent` → marker absent from all 232 built files. Guard run → **1 failed | 102 passed (103)**:
  ```
  FAIL  src/feature-gate-guard.test.ts > feature-gate completeness guard (#2874) > reverse: every features.* gate in the objects is booked in the registry > sys_team.actions.add_team_member references registered flag organization and is booked
  AssertionError: sys_team.actions.add_team_member is booked in organization.gatedInputs: expected false to be true
  ```
- Restore: blob back to `bc905d9641b5` (equal to HEAD), `git diff HEAD` empty, whole-tree `git status --porcelain` clean; spec rebuilt; preflight (present) → marker in 30 built files, tree clean. Guard run → **104 passed (104)** (the booked row also adds its forward-direction case).

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 91 commands for this change set; every one was run on `67affbcd1` and recorded as `cmd :: exit N`. All 91 exit 0. Four first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `check:i18n`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needed built packages, and the `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` fixture commit was outside the shallow clone). Each was re-run after the named prerequisite was met (the i18n closure build; fetching the pinned fixture commit) and exited 0. `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` → "91 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 91 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". Local-only `node scripts/check-dev-prereqs.mjs` → exit 0. CI owns the type-check lanes, Test Core, Build Core and the roster families outside the derived set.

## Acceptance notes

- No new runtime path: the action is metadata only, and it reuses an endpoint and gates that are already served.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/public-feature-registry.test.ts` also imports `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES`, but it reads flag names and semantics only, never `gatedInputs`. It was not run locally (its dependency closure is unbuilt here); CI's Test Core runs it.
